lines.zh: 我顺着冷流往下游冲。
lines.en: I race downstream along the cold current.

lines.zh: 石缝里穿过去，鳞都没蹭掉。
lines.en: I slip through a stone gap without losing a scale.

lines.zh: 我摆尾快得像抽鞭子。
lines.en: My tail beats fast, like a cracking whip.

lines.zh: 水浅了，我贴着卵石走。
lines.en: The water shallows, so I skim over the gravel.

lines.zh: 转弯时我侧身让开水草。
lines.en: Turning, I tilt sideways to clear the weeds.

lines.zh: 上游化雪，水冷得刺骨。
lines.en: Snowmelt upstream makes the water bite cold.

lines.zh: 我顶着急流往前挤。
lines.en: I push forward against the fast current.

lines.zh: 河底石头滑，我小心绕。
lines.en: The river stones are slick, so I go around carefully.

lines.zh: 我一串小抖，游出半米。
lines.en: A quick shiver of my body carries me half a meter.

lines.zh: 河湾缓，我慢慢晃过去。
lines.en: The bend is calm, and I drift through it slowly.

lines.zh: 我跟着水面的碎叶子走。
lines.en: I follow the broken leaves on the surface.

lines.zh: 急流冲我，我换个水道。
lines.en: The rapids shove me, so I take another channel.

lines.zh: 我贴底游，怕被上面看见。
lines.en: I hug the bottom so nothing above can spot me.

lines.zh: 过了浅滩，我才敢快起来。
lines.en: Past the shallows, I finally dare to speed up.

lines.zh: 我斜着身子切进主流。
lines.en: I cut into the main current at an angle.

lines.zh: 卵石硌着肚子，我贴着过。
lines.en: Pebbles scrape my belly; I keep low.

lines.zh: 水面碎光晃眼，我沉下去。
lines.en: The broken light blinds me, so I sink.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根泡烂的木头。
lines.en: I swing around a waterlogged log.

lines.zh: 我悬在石头阴影里不动。
lines.en: I hang in the shadow of a stone, motionless.

lines.zh: 冷水刷过我的鳃，很舒服。
lines.en: Cold water brushes my gills, and it feels good.

lines.zh: 有只水虫飘过，我没理。
lines.en: A water bug drifts past, and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，让阳光照斑纹。
lines.en: I turn sideways to let sun reach my speckles.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我懒得摆尾。
lines.en: The current nudges me, and I cannot be bothered to swim.

lines.zh: 河底很静，只有石头响。
lines.en: The riverbed is quiet except for knocking stones.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，喝了一口凉水。
lines.en: I open my mouth and take a sip of cold water.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴在卵石上歇着。
lines.en: I rest my belly against the gravel.

lines.zh: 一片叶子盖住了我的背。
lines.en: A leaf settles over my back.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面上的光点看。
lines.en: I stare at the glints on the surface.

lines.zh: 有影子过来，我先沉下去。
lines.en: A shadow comes, so I sink first.

lines.zh: 我抖抖鳍，甩掉一点沙。
lines.en: I shake my fins and flick off some sand.

lines.zh: 这处河湾的水最凉。
lines.en: The water in this bend is the coldest.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打了个嗝，冒个泡。
lines.en: I open my mouth, burp, and one bubble rises.

lines.zh: 岸上那双靴子，一直没动。
lines.en: Those boots on the bank have not moved at all.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你的靴子。
lines.en: I study your boots through the water.

lines.zh: 你的影子把河面压暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow dims the river surface.

lines.zh: 你手里有根竿，对吧？
lines.en: There is a rod in your hand, right?

lines.zh: 我绕着你踩出的水花转。
lines.en: I circle the splashes your feet made.

lines.zh: 你一蹲，我钻进石头底下。
lines.en: When you crouch, I duck under the stone.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水里晃来晃去。
lines.en: Your face wobbles about in the water.

lines.zh: 这脚步踩碎石，我听过。
lines.en: That footfall crunching gravel, I have heard it before.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，水会浑。
lines.en: Do not come closer, the water will cloud.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，回看你一眼。
lines.en: I hold still and look back at you once.

lines.zh: 疼！我的鳞被刮掉了。
lines.en: Ouch! My scales got scraped off.

lines.zh: 别捏，我只有八点血。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me, I only have eight health.

lines.zh: 肚皮朝上了，我挣着翻回来。
lines.en: Belly up, I struggle until I right myself.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我就想躲。
lines.en: When the water clouds, I want to hide.

lines.zh: 这一下让我尾巴发僵。
lines.en: That blow left my tail stiff.

lines.zh: 我甩尾逃开，撞了石头。
lines.en: I flee with a tail flick and hit a stone.

lines.zh: 我的鳃动得厉害。
lines.en: My gills are working far too fast.

lines.zh: 别追了，我游不快。
lines.en: Stop chasing, I cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底装死。
lines.en: I press to the riverbed and play dead.

lines.zh: 掉了几片鳞，随水漂走。
lines.en: A few scales drift away with the water.

lines.zh: 那条虫在钩上扭得真欢。
lines.en: That worm on the hook wriggles so eagerly.

lines.zh: 你撒的碎饵落到我头上。
lines.en: Your scattered crumbs land on my head.

lines.zh: 我游开又回来，嘴都张开了。
lines.en: I swim off, come back, and my mouth is already open.

lines.zh: 饵的味道拐过石头，找到我。
lines.en: The bait's smell rounds the stone and finds me.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了一下，是空的。
lines.en: I test a bite, and it is empty.

lines.zh: 你把饵放低点，我够得着。
lines.en: Lower the bait and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我盯着那团东西不敢动。
lines.en: I stare at that lump, afraid to move.

lines.zh: 这么冷的水，吃点热的。
lines.en: In water this cold, something warm would help.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，又吐出来。
lines.en: I bite once, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 再来一点，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more bit and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 你趟水过来，撞散了我。
lines.en: You waded over and scattered me.

lines.zh: 我的背擦过你的小腿。
lines.en: My back grazed your calf.

lines.zh: 急流把我们挤到一处。
lines.en: The rapids squeezed us into one spot.

lines.zh: 靴子落下来，我贴着河沙躲。
lines.en: A boot comes down, and I press into the river sand.

lines.zh: 我撞上石头，眼冒金星。
lines.en: I hit a stone and saw stars.

lines.zh: 两条鱼一起挤进石缝。
lines.en: Two of us squeeze into one stone gap.

lines.zh: 你的网碰到我的尾巴了。
lines.en: Your net touched my tail.

lines.zh: 我弹开半尺，水花四溅。
lines.en: I dart half a foot away, splashing everywhere.

lines.zh: 河底太窄，谁也别挤。
lines.en: The riverbed is narrow, so nobody shove.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，算打招呼。
lines.en: I bumped you once, which counts as hello.

lines.zh: 她身上的斑点比我密。
lines.en: Her speckles are denser than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排顶着急流游。
lines.en: We swim side by side against the current.

lines.zh: 我侧身贴她，尾鳍轻轻扫。
lines.en: I turn my flank to hers, tail fin sweeping lightly.

lines.zh: 她在卵石上蹭肚子。
lines.en: She rubs her belly on the gravel.

lines.zh: 冷河里，只有我们两条。
lines.en: In this cold river there are only us two.

lines.zh: 我把最深的石缝让给她。
lines.en: I give her the deepest crevice.

lines.zh: 我们贴着侧身，一起摆尾。
lines.en: We press flank to flank and beat our tails together.

lines.zh: 她的鳍碰我，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Her fin touches me, and I twitch.

lines.zh: 沙床被我们扫出浅坑。
lines.en: We sweep a shallow pit in the sandy bed.

lines.zh: 等水暖些，这里会有小鱼。
lines.en: When the water warms, small fry will be here.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我叼住了。
lines.en: Something sank, and I caught it.

lines.zh: 这粒饵我藏到石头下。
lines.en: I hide this bait under a stone.

lines.zh: 你的钩上的虫，我拿走了。
lines.en: The worm on your hook is mine now.

lines.zh: 亮闪闪的，我不太敢碰。
lines.en: It glitters, and I am not quite brave enough.

lines.zh: 我把叶子拖进石缝里。
lines.en: I drag the leaf into a stone gap.

lines.zh: 这块面包屑顺流漂来的。
lines.en: This crumb came floating down the current.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞着东西，说不出话。
lines.en: My mouth is full, so I cannot say a word.

lines.zh: 别丢钩子，会挂住我。
lines.en: Do not drop hooks, they snag on me.

lines.zh: 小东西我都捡，饿了再吃。
lines.en: I pick up every little thing and eat when hungry.

lines.zh: 我顶着一片花瓣游走了。
lines.en: I swim off balancing a petal on my head.

lines.zh: 上面有个影子，比鱼大。
lines.en: There is a shadow above, bigger than a fish.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道有谁来了。
lines.en: The water stirs, and I know someone has come.

lines.zh: 那只水虫离我不到一指。
lines.en: That water bug is less than a finger away.

lines.zh: 岸上有人，我先躲石头后。
lines.en: Someone is on the bank, so I hide behind a stone.

lines.zh: 是条大鱼，它看见我了。
lines.en: It is a big fish, and it has seen me.

lines.zh: 网的影子落下来，我认得。
lines.en: The shadow of a net falls, and I know it.

lines.zh: 水面在响，有东西在挣扎。
lines.en: The surface rattles; something up there is struggling.

lines.zh: 我盯着那点动静不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I watch that small disturbance without blinking.

lines.zh: 钩子沉下来了，我绕开。
lines.en: A hook sinks down, and I swim around it.

lines.zh: 它张嘴了，比我想的大。
lines.en: It opens its mouth, wider than I expected.

lines.zh: 它顺着水流找我，慢慢来。
lines.en: It follows the current toward me, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我缩进石缝，只露尾巴。
lines.en: I shrink into a crevice, only my tail showing.

lines.zh: 它绕了两圈，还没走。
lines.en: It circled twice and has not left.

lines.zh: 我数着它的鳍，等它靠近。
lines.en: I count its fins and wait for it to close in.

lines.zh: 水变浑了，我看不清它。
lines.en: The water muddied, and I cannot see it now.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就往下沉。
lines.en: The moment it turns, I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，装成碎石。
lines.en: I turn broadside and pass for a piece of gravel.

lines.zh: 它嗅我的味道，我屏住鳃。
lines.en: It tastes my scent, so I hold my gills shut.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就窜出去。
lines.en: A little closer and I will bolt.

lines.zh: 它停在石头上方，不动了。
lines.en: It stops above the stone and holds still.

lines.zh: 我甩尾抽它的嘴。
lines.en: I lash my tail across its mouth.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的须不放。
lines.en: I clamp onto its barbel and will not let go.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，弹回来，头晕。
lines.en: I ram it, bounce back, and my head spins.

lines.zh: 它皮太硬，我牙都酸了。
lines.en: Its hide is so tough my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 我冲它眼睛啄一下。
lines.en: I dart in and peck its eye.

lines.zh: 水花一炸，我们撞成一团。
lines.en: The water bursts, and we crash into one knot.

lines.zh: 我用力顶它的下巴。
lines.en: I ram my head hard into its chin.

lines.zh: 打不过，我也咬掉它一片鳞。
lines.en: I cannot win, but I still bite off a scale.

lines.zh: 我拿头撞，像撞石头。
lines.en: I butt it with my head, like hitting rock.

lines.zh: 我折腾半天，只搅浑了水。
lines.en: I struggle a while and only muddy the water.

lines.zh: 我从冷河里冒出来，一条。
lines.en: I appear in the cold river, just one.

lines.zh: 雪水刚化，我就出现了。
lines.en: The snowmelt had barely thawed when I appeared.

lines.zh: 这条河以前没我，现在有了。
lines.en: This river had no me before, and now it does.

lines.zh: 卵石缝里，我摆尾钻出来。
lines.en: I wiggle out of a gap in the gravel.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我正好喜欢。
lines.en: The water is cold, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我一落地就往深处游。
lines.en: The moment I land, I swim for deeper water.

lines.zh: 浅滩上只有我一个影子。
lines.en: On the shallows there is only my shadow.

lines.zh: 溪水推我，我顺势往下。
lines.en: The stream pushes me, and I go with it.

lines.zh: 我在河湾里找了块石头。
lines.en: I find a stone in the river bend.

lines.zh: 这条河够冷，我留下来了。
lines.en: This river is cold enough, so I stay.

lines.zh: 河面上有火，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The river surface is on fire, so I dive deep.

lines.zh: 钩子把我甩上河岸的石滩。
lines.en: The hook flings me onto the riverbank shingle.

lines.zh: 鳃贴在空气里，一点用没有。
lines.en: My gills lie in open air and do nothing.

lines.zh: 水一震，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The water jolts, and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 有根细东西扎穿我的鳍。
lines.en: Something slender pierced through my fin.

lines.zh: 光一闪，我的鳞全竖起来。
lines.en: Light flashes, and every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 水太冷，我什么也没吃着。
lines.en: The water is too cold and I caught nothing.

lines.zh: 雷落在河上，我浑身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning hit the river and my whole body jerked.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我在往下坠。
lines.en: There is no water here, and I keep falling.
